'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|VB4-L-watchyourstep-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Agnos-Tic
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2

== Decklist ==

The sheet says the deck is the same as the player's [[2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Greg Shaw LS Watch Your Step (V)|list from the day before]]. The list below is that list.
